note: Where each exterior region sits on the continent map the Tab map shows. Positions are metres on one canvas, x east and y south, and name the centre of the region's playable rectangle; the rectangle's size is the region's own, read from its package, so the map is to scale - one metre here is one metre there. The arrangement is the one region-connections.json describes: Four Gates on its island in the middle of the lake, Crownwater's archipelago on the lake west of it, nine regions in a ring clockwise from the north at forty-degree steps on a radius of 1280 m, and the Whitehorn Range beyond the ring to the north-west, above Amberwood and Mirrorhold. Nudge a centre to move a region; tools/build_continent_map.py refuses overlaps.
